question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Compulsory
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Compulsory"** means something that is required by law or a rule; obligatory. (अनिवार्य)

 
 
• **Example: **Wearing a seatbelt in a car is** compulsory **in many countries.
 
 
 
• **"Optional"** refers to something that is available to be chosen but not obligatory; voluntary. (वैकल्पिक)
 
 
• **Example: **Attendance at the seminar is** optional,** but highly recommended.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Compulsory'** is **'Optional'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Reliable** (विश्वसनीय): Consistently good in quality or performance; able to be trusted.

 
 
• **Example:** She is a reliable employee who always meets her deadlines.
 
 
 
• **Factional** (गुटीय): Relating to a small organized dissenting group within a larger one, especially in politics.
 
 
• **Example:** The factional disputes within the party have weakened its overall effectiveness.
 
 
 
• **Full-fledged** (पूर्ण विकसित): Completely developed or established; of full status.
 
 
• **Example:** He is now a full-fledged professor at the university.
